release_notes:
This release fixes an issue where a successful payment sometimes did not add credits to the customer's account, most often on someone's very first payment.

What changed:
- Payments made through any supported method (PayPal, Stripe, Wise, Binance, PayerURL, or invoice payments) now reliably add credits to the customer's account right after a successful payment.
- If an admin needed to manually approve a stuck payment, the approval now correctly adds the customer's credits at the same time, instead of only updating the payment's status.

Customers affected by this in the past can be resolved by re-approving the payment from the admin panel; credits will be added automatically and safely, with no risk of adding them twice.
